name: The Viathlon Games
summary:
The Viathlon Games let you dive into the virtual world of sports.

Skillfully navigate a whitewater river in your canoe before being confronted with clay pigeons that need to be shot down. Climb and hang your way up a steep rock face to get there and shoot at targets with a bow and arrow. Take your ski poles in hand and race through the icy snowy landscape to the steep downhill slope.
